work.name: Amazon Web Services
highlights: Engineered a challenge-response authentication system for secure serial access to Linux networking devices, implementing a Rust PAM module to validate cryptographically signed, user-specific credentials
Built a Go-based signing service to authorize device access and issue signed credentials using a certificate chain, enabling offline credential validation and user-level auditing
Developed a React Web Serial application with an integrated terminal to automate device authentication and credential exchange, simplifying secure access for data center operators

work.name: University of Minnesota, Department of Computer Science & Engineering

Mentored students through semester-long projects involving dataset collection, annotation, model design, training, and evaluation methodologies
Provided detailed grading and technical feedback on assignments and projects

work.name: University of Minnesota, Knowledge Computing Lab
work.summary: Mentor: JangHyeon Lee, Advisor: Yao-Yi Chiang
highlights: Led development of SolarCLIP, a domain-adapted vision–language model for solar physics by selectively fine-tuning CLIP’s projection heads and targeted transformer layers
Designed and ran a full machine learning experimentation pipeline including model training, evaluation tooling, data preprocessing, and embedding-space analysis

work.name: ImageTrend

Created an interface for managing geocoding data sources and viewing logs using React and Material UI
Refactored legacy code to improve performance and integrate latest features
Achieved 100% unit test coverage across backend and frontend components

work.name: Best Buy

projects.name: API Monitor

Built a real-time dashboard with Google OAuth, configurable response schemas, and WebSockets to detect unreachable endpoints and breaking API changes, with public tracker discovery for shared monitoring
